name: Whirl
description: Begin spinning your weapon to threaten other creatures within a 10 ft. sphere. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Reflex saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d10 + your weapon's damage modifier and half as much on a success. Falling Prone, being Restrained or Grappled, or getting Disarmed automatically ends this Prowess.
